subject: Request: Rolling invoice window / conditional Net-90 for Lumera Health
messages:
From: Emma Stone <emma@lumerahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumera Health Procurement <procure@lumerahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Rolling invoice window / conditional Net-90

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with latency and throughput for our embeddings-heavy workflows. We are proceeding internally but have a procurement constraint I wanted to flag early: Lumera is requesting a rolling invoice window (Net-90) for the first two quarters of production because of a recent cashflow timing shift with their payer contracts.

Attached is the PO they can issue (Lumera_PO_5678.pdf) and a spreadsheet that sketches their proposed payment milestones. They expect to commit to a 12-month contract and want Redwood to invoice on a rolling quarterly schedule (one invoice each quarter, with payment due Net-90 from invoice date).

They also asked if Redwood would agree to a 90-day payment term without a discount in exchange for: 1) an irrevocable PO for the year, 2) monthly usage reporting, and 3) a short pilot period (90 days) to validate traffic.

Please let me know what approvals we need and whether your team needs additional financial safeguards (retainer, escrow, or an early-pay credit). If possible, Lumera would like an answer by Tue so procurement can include it in their board packet.

Thanks,
Emma Stone
Head of Partnerships
Lumera Health

Attachment: Lumera_PO_5678.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: lumera-proposed-payment-schedule.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Rolling invoice window / conditional Net-90

Team — forwarding Lumera's request. High level: 12-month commitment, ask is rolling quarterly invoices with Net-90 due date. They propose no pricing concession; ask is purely payment timing.

My read: this could be a strategic enterprise account (payer integrations), but the cashflow exposure is material. Requested approvals we should consider:
- Conditional Net-90 pilot limited to first 90 days, then auto-review (unless they meet SLAs and payment cadence).
- Require a 25% upfront retainer OR an irrevocable PO that covers minimum spend for the first 90 days.
- Monthly usage reporting + weekly billing reconciliation while on Net-90.
- Add a clause for expedited collection at our discretion if usage exceeds expected thresholds.

Can you weigh in quickly on acceptable mitigations and whether Finance would accept PO + monthly reporting as sufficient? I've attached their PO and payment schedule. Lumera needs an answer by Tue for their board packet.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Rolling invoice window / conditional Net-90

Irene — thanks for flagging. A few quick thoughts:

1) Credit exposure: what's the projected ARR and monthly burn in the PO? Need to quantify likely outstanding receivable at peak.
2) If we require a 25% retainer that should materially reduce risk; alternatively, PO with bank guarantee or escrow could be acceptable.
3) Pilot duration: 90 days is reasonable, but recommend limiting the pilot spend (cap to X% of annual committed spend) to avoid unbounded exposure.

Marcus/Finance — do you have thresholds (credit limits) for new enterprise customers on Net-90? If we can get Finance to accept PO + monthly reporting with a retainer of 20–30%, I'm OK to escalate approval to Marcus for signoff.

Jonas
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Rolling invoice window / conditional Net-90

All — after reviewing the PO and projected monthly run-rate, Finance is willing to approve a conditional Net-90 but with these firm requirements: 

1) 25% upfront retainer (applied to first invoice) OR an irrevocable bank-guaranteed PO covering at least the first 90 days' minimum spend.
2) Quarterly invoicing as requested, but invoices must include detailed usage reconciliations. Payment remains Net-90 from invoice date.
3) A 90-day pilot cap: we will limit exposure to 35% of the total annual committed value during the pilot.
4) Contract addendum: early-pay discount clause (0.5% per 30 days early, capped at 1.5%) and an automatic review/rollback clause at pilot end.
5) Legal to include a cure period and rights to suspend service on missed payment beyond 30 days after due date.

If Lumera agrees to (1) a signed SOW referencing the irrevocable PO or retainer, (2) the pilot cap, and (3) monthly reporting, Marcus will sign off on the conditional Net-90 for the initial 90-day pilot. Please confirm and I'll prepare a short exec approval note for the contract team.

Marcus Lin
VP, Finance & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
